name: cyoa-game-master
description: An interactive, text-based Choose-Your-Own-Adventure (CYOA) game powered by AI.

scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist && shx mkdir dist && shx cp index.html sw.js manifest.json metadata.json index.css dist/ && esbuild index.tsx --bundle --outfile=dist/index.js --jsx=automatic --external:react --external:react-dom/client --external:react-markdown --external:remark-gfm --external:@xenova/transformers --external:@google/genai
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
